name: Iochpe-Maxion S.A.
summary: Iochpe-Maxion S.A., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells automotive wheels and structural components in Brazil, North America, South America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia, and internationally. The company offers aluminum wheels, steel wheels, and structural components for commercial and light vehicles. It also provides side rails and chassis for commercial vehicles; stamped parts for light vehicles; and railway equipment. Iochpe-Maxion S.A. was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Cruzeiro, Brazil.
